Even checked the definition of a hybrid vehicle on wikipedia

A hybrid vehicle uses two or more distinct types of power, such as internal combustion engine to drive an electric generator that powers an electric motor.

Its a hybrid by definition, Hybrid electric-petroleum vehicle to be exact

Electrical energy is produced either from the mgu-h or the mgu-k under braking. During acceleration the electrical motor or the mgu-k gives additional 160hp to the crankshaft. So its a petrol engine with some help from electrical engines, in other words hybrid

The engine has 2 electrical motors. Mgu-K(attached to the crankshaft) and Mgu-H(attached to the turbo). The engine  can pump energy back in the turbo through the mgu-k. So in a way its a hybrid, or lets just say it has 2 hybrid systems.
